name: youtube-mcp
description: Paste a YouTube link and read its transcript, from the video's own or auto-generated captions. No API key, no Google account.
long_description: Reads the captions of a public YouTube video (uploaded by the channel or auto-generated by YouTube) and hands Claude the text, with the title, channel, duration and the language used. Works with watch links, youtu.be links, Shorts and bare video ids. Read-only: it needs no account, stores nothing, and talks to youtube.com only. A video with no captions gets a clear message; this extension does not download audio. Open source under the MIT license.

tools.name: youtube_get_transcript
tools.description: Read the transcript of a YouTube video, in plain paragraphs or with timestamps.

tools.name: youtube_list_transcript_languages
tools.description: List the caption languages a YouTube video has.

default_language.title: Preferred caption language (optional)
default_language.description: A language code such as es or en, used when you don't ask for one. Leave empty to get each video in the language it is spoken in.
